sentences.text:
The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Patna High Court CWJC No.11917 of 2023(2)
dt.09-01-2025 petitioners submits that the petitioners came to know through notice issued under Section 19(1) in Hindi News Paper 'Dainik Bhaskar' dated 09.05.2023 by the District Magistrate,
Patna that lands of the petitioners as detailed at Para-4 of the writ application is going to be acquired for construction of Ghuran Bigha Road to Bherharia Siyarampur Road.

The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the manner in which the lands of the petitioners has been acquired for the aforesaid purpose is in complete breach of the right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re- settlement Act, 2013 (herein after referred to as the Act).
3.

entities.text: Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re- settlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the Act contemplates the procedure how land is to be acquired.

It is next submitted that no notice under Section 11 of the aforesaid Act of 2013 was issued either in the local gazette or in two daily news paper, as such, the petitioners were not in a position to submit their objection in terms of Section 15 of the Act.
It is submitted that it is settled principles of law that an act has to be done in the manner prescribed and not in any other manner.
It is also submitted that Section 16 of the Act, 2013 was also not adhere to.

It is further submitted that the land have been acquired after publication of notice under Section 19(1) of the Patna High Court CWJC No.11917 of 2023(2) dt.09-01-2025 Act, 2013 by giving a complete go by to Sections 11, 15 and 16 of the 2013 Act and the work has commenced, but then, the work has not been completed till date.

It is further submitted that since the procedure as prescribed under the Act, 2013 has not been complied while acquiring the land of the petitioners, as such, the instant writ application has been filed seeking quashing of the notice dated 09.05.2023 published in Hindi News Paper 'Dainik Bhaskar' under Section 19(1) of the Act and also for quashing the award nos.1, 2, 4 and 5 issued under Section 37(2) of the Act of 2013.
The learned counsel for the petitioners reiterates, asserts and submits that the work has commenced recently and as such, the construction of the road has not been completed.
4. The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State seeks two weeks' time for filing a counter-affidavit.

5. Put up this case on 04.02.2025 within top ten cases.
6.

If the road for which the land has been acquired has not been completed till date, in that event,
status quo as existing as of date shall be maintained.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) vikash/-
